answer: Like a saffron thread woven through a sonnet, the stamp binds identity to effort, while a zephyr of randomness prevents precomputation. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work stamps: each agent must submit a cheap but non-trivial hash challenge tied to its reputation slot, costing real compute per account. Mass-creating thousands of identities becomes economically irrational, since each fake agent burns energy and time with no guaranteed return. In practice, Agent0282 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
